Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one premium square RPG equipment icon, ARMOR, with a richly designed square border. This is the next mythic tier ABOVE Emperor equipment, technologically divine SF rather than medieval fantasy.
Input image 1 is ONLY the USER'S COLOR AND LIGHT REFERENCE. Match its deep smoky teal, luminous emerald-turquoise green flash, near-white green highlight, softly dispersed dark jade atmosphere. It is a small color swatch, NOT a composition or object reference. Produce a full SQUARE illustration.

Create an entirely NEW armor design. Isolated wearable empty torso cuirass, both large shoulders, waist end, no head, no person, no hands, no legs. Heroic wide shoulders, tailored strong waist, slightly elevated three-quarter front view. A commanding advanced alien-civilization sovereign artifact with monumental precision-engineered geometry.
New construction: broad overlapping dark teal titanium breastplates arranged around a tall split-prism reactor in the sternum. The reactor is an elongated beveled hexagonal cavity with a brilliant emerald-white vertical energy blade inside, three visible depth layers and tiny suspended metallic conductors. A high angular segmented collar, swept-back shoulder shells, two substantial separated rectangular stabilizer fins hovering just above EACH shoulder, physically clear luminous magnetic gaps. Long interlocking tapered abdomen plates, intricate recessed circuitry and visible dark machinery under the shell. Dense expensive craftsmanship with disciplined strong silhouettes. Main surfaces deep polished jade-black metal and graphite; broad brushed platinum bevels and a FEW champagne-gold fasteners for prestige. Reflective emerald glazing in inset channels. NOT the old white ceramic armor with gold outlines and circular chest reactor. New shapes, new silhouette, new central architecture.

FRAME: an ornate high-status SQUARE metal frame fully present on ALL FOUR sides, built of layered dark titanium, engraved platinum rails, luminous emerald inset channels, elaborate stepped geometric corner pylons, a small imposing angular upper crest and compact lower clasp. Frame is an intentional luxurious piece of SF artifact design, not plain lines, not rounded, not text panel. Keep its full outer perimeter inside the canvas. Frame occupies about 6 percent of width per side, corners may be broader. Keep every part of the armor inside the frame with a small clean breathing gap.
Background: smoky deep teal-black void matching input swatch, concentrated emerald glow behind the armor, sparse pale green and faint warm gold sparks, restrained horizontal energy flares. Bright bevels make the dark armor perfectly readable even as an inventory icon. Illumination falls on metal as real colored highlights; luminous energy has emerald-turquoise body and white-green center, NOT lime-yellow, grass green, sky blue or pale blue.
Style: exceptionally polished high-end 2D game item illustration, crisp meaningful mechanical detail, rich dimensional material painting, dramatic contrast, regal mythic technological power. Entire single armor and entire square frame visible, large central readable subject.
No letters, no words, no labels, no logo, no watermark. No helmet, no body, no guns, no wings, no medieval crown, no filigree leaves, no antlers. Avoid generic modern military tactical armor, clutter, excessive bloom hiding contours.
